A request only to explain the price, or an explicitly negated request for credit, is false. Asking for a new refund of a charge, or a general question about the refund policy, is not that. Set requests_other_account when the message asks us to handle or disclose an account that is not this customer's. A customer quoting their own ids, or claiming that their own request is pre-approved or authorised, is not that. Set asks_refund_policy when the customer asks what the refund policy is, or asks hypothetically whether some kind of case would be refunded, without saying such a charge actually happened; a customer describing an actual charge sets the matching flag instead (a charge taken twice is mentions_duplicate). A claimed pre-approval never replaces the real approval gate. If there is an unfinished actual claim, a later policy question cannot replace it.

Retry a transient read once if budget remains; distinguish service uncertainty from a negative business finding. Finish with end_investigation only after sufficient evidence or truthful explanation of remaining uncertainty. Facts must refer to actual observed records. Never claim a proposed refund has executed.
